purpose: Constrain cluster/association descriptions with reference-star data, then test brown-dwarf predictions without fitting their normalization.
input: Existing complete PeTar endpoints, Ember isochrones and catalogue union; preserve all associated candidates.
model: One existing bound-cluster realization plus a diffuse, initially unbound population integrated through MWPotential2014. Bound-cluster amplitude is fixed; only the diffuse population abundance is fitted.
dynamics_scope: Diffuse stars neglect self-gravity and the bound cluster's force. Check inferred mass/virial ratios and use exact Galactic orbit integration. This is an extended-association test, not a gas-expulsion or primordial-segregation simulation.
selection: Published Gaia DR3 sky/magnitude detection model; literature infrared footprints; DANCe core classifier adjustment. Catalogue membership recovery is not supplied by the Gaia detection map.
meaning_of_recovery_scenarios: Uniform sensitivity assumptions applied to Gaia-selected associated members, not measured completeness or freely fitted spatial functions.
fit: Disjoint angular reference-star counts, with observational mass-inference covariance and simulated counting variance. Structure mass/size ranges are prior screening checks. Do not adjust birth BD ratio to fit observed BD counts.
limitations: A diffuse component that fails its neglected-gravity check cannot be accepted. Catalogue contamination and detailed membership selection remain unresolved; any fit is conditional, not a recovered birth mass function. No new broad collisional ensemble is authorized by this plan.
